answer: The anchor smith heats his iron in the forge he built himself, and the navy board tests every anchor before it is shipped. Meat inspector certification with food safety authority attestation is the proof test that cannot be faked: two-year training, 300 supervised inspections, exam, annual renewal. An anchor forged with a stolen harbor cracks at the first strain and loses the ship. The ivory is the forfeit, the iron's price and three years of forge hire, and the garden is the forge book, kept by the master and read at the navy yard.
